## Summary

Fixed `_is_class_var` in `src/attr/_make.py` to unwrap `typing.ForwardRef` objects via `__forward_arg__` before stringifying, so a `ClassVar` annotation that gets turned into a bare `ForwardRef` (e.g. an unimported `ClassVar[str]` under newer Python annotation-evaluation semantics) is still recognized as a class variable instead of being treated as a regular attribute. Added the corresponding `test_is_class_var` parametrize case, the `test_missing_classvar_import` regression test, and a changelog fragment (`changelog.d/1593.change.md`), matching the upstream fix. Full test suite passes (1386 passed); the only failures are pre-existing, unrelated to this change (a dev-version string issue from the local editable install).
